tools.name: search_stores
tools.description: Search for cashback-eligible stores by name or keyword. Returns store name, cashback rate, and category.

tools.name: get_store_details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific store including all cashback tiers, active coupons, and categories.

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Find active coupon codes and deals. Optionally filter by store ID or search by keyword.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all shopping categories with store counts.

tools.name: get_stores_by_category
tools.description: Get all cashback stores in a specific category.

tools.name: get_activation_url
tools.description: Get the cashback activation URL for a store. Users must click this link before shopping to earn cashback.

tools.name: activate_cashback
tools.description: Generate a personalized cashback activation link for a user. Requires the user's Tenmomo API key (sk-tm-...). The returned URL must be opened in a browser to set tracking cookies before shopping.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "activate_cashback" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
